title: Welcome to week 4 of the #100musicalchallenge
transcript: We're listening to 100 cast albums in 2026. And this week we are listening to two shows where the lines blur between an author and their creation. Our Broadway show is city of Angels, which is the Cy Coleman musical from 1989 about a screenwriter writing a film noir movie based off of a popular novel series and how the character kind of comes to life. And the Beyond Broadway show is the concept album for Beautiful Little Fool, which is a new musical about the Fitzgeralds told from the perspective of their child. This just started a run in London at the Southern Playhouse, Burrow. But they did create a concept album a few years ago that I've not gotten around to listen to it. I'm really excited. Apparently uses a lot of pop music influences while telling the story of arguably one of the most famous couples of the 1920s.
